Mint Orbit takes your senses on a smooth spin through space with its big, sexy tops that smell like bubblegum gas and spearmint gelato. Each bud glows with frosty trichomes and a cool, minty finish that’ll have hash lovers grinning ear to ear. It’s the kind of strain that smells too good to hide from your friends.
